Theorem 3.16. In Theorem 3.15, assume that ฿ = P(X) and that Bo contains all the finite subsets of X. IfE has the uap, then so does E. Likewise for "uniformly supported".

Question 3.18. Assume that Bo and B, are fields of sets over X, containing all the singletons, and Eo and E, are uniformly supported fams with the uap on 8o and 81, respectively. Assume that Eo and E, are compatible (in the sense of Theorem 3.8 (iii)).

A strategy to solve this problem may suggest a short proof of Theorem 3.8.
